value.answer: Sounds like you've got a lot on your plate. Your family doctor is usually the easiest place to start: they can give you a referral, and many insurers will only cover therapy with someone on their list, so check that too. If things feel urgent or you're not safe, call 988 in the US or your local crisis line any time. If you tell me roughly what you're dealing with, I can help you think through what kind of therapist might fit.
